counting_policy: Fixed 70-unit residual MVP baseline. Each unit counts once, only with source and authored scenario evidence; no test PASS required. Open includes implemented but not fully traced. Splits preserve parent total weight; scope changes require dated baseline revision. Shared code is counted once. Historical log percentages are obsolete block metric.

reporting_policy.overall: Preserve fixed 70-unit baseline; subdivided children sum to parent weight 1. Credit only individually traced source + authored scenarios. No credit from file count or estimated partial percentage.
reporting_policy.detail: Report weighted overall percentage and active parent closed/total children. P0.1.09 is frozen at 30 equal children; one child contributes 100/(70*30)=0.047619 percentage points. Require static source + authored scenario trace before credit. Pending audit is not missing implementation.
reporting_policy.precision: Six decimal places for overall percentage and percentage-point delta; also show active microstep closed/total. No credit for decomposition or unaudited code.
reporting_policy.update_format: After each statically traced substep closure report: ID and concrete result; active child closed/total substeps; previous -> current overall coding percentage; delta in percentage points; next substep. Freeze substeps before credit; replace their fractional contribution when child closes, never double count. Unclosed work earns no numeric credit.
reporting_policy.local_progress: Always pair the weighted overall metric with the active section closed/total count and concrete completed result. Freeze smaller acceptance-based results before work when needed; preserve total weight. Interim work can be reported descriptively but earns no numeric credit until the criterion is complete.
reporting_policy.microstep_delta: Current five-way split of a P0.1.09 child: 100/(70*30*5) = 0.009523809523809524 percentage points. Report six decimals. Reopened criteria subtract the same fixed weight; no credit for policy/documentation-only updates.
reporting_policy.fine_grained_generation_final_trace: Four equal parts frozen before closure; each contributes 1/160 unit, or 1/112 percentage point of the fixed 70-unit residual plan. No credit for subdivision itself.
